edbDesc: A process in which gas transforms into solid (also known as desublimation). The reverse of deposition is sublimation. One example of deposition is the process by which, in sub-freezing air, water vapour changes directly to ice without first becoming a liquid. This is how snow forms in clouds, as well as frost and hoar frost on the ground.
title: Deposition (physical)
pickWhy: An everyday phase change (frost forming straight from vapour), like freezing.
